At the final transition, after the other gates pass and the DOI metadata is final, stage the release-form STATUS (archived_release, citable_release true, all gates passed). For this gate, passed means that the metadata and staged payload are ready for the inner-freeze transaction; it does not attest a published tag, an uploaded archive, or an out-of-repository deposit receipt. Run freeze_release.py create; only if it succeeds, stage MANIFEST.sha256, commit, and create the local tag. A create failure must not be committed or published. The post-tag deposit comparison and receipt remain outside the repository and are not embedded evidence for this gate.
